turns.user: I don't have a monthly pass, and I'm bringing my small dog on a tram.
turns.agent:
Is your dog in a fully closed carrier, or travelling on a leash and muzzle? That changes which condition applies.

For a tram in Budapest, the snapshot says your dog can travel free if it is in a suitable, fully closed carrier. If it rides outside a carrier, the known conditions are a leash and muzzle. Carry valid animal vaccination documentation. The snapshot does not specify a separate dog-fare price for someone without a pass, so I can’t infer one from it; your own tram fare is separate.

These details come from my 5 November 2026 knowledge snapshot, not a live check. See BKK’s Dogs on public transport (https://bkk.hu/en/travel-information/dogs-on-public-transport/) for the current rule.
